newsitem.title: UK: Nestle to launch mint version of Kit Kat brand.
newsitem.headline: Nestle to launch mint version of Kit Kat brand.

text.p: Nestle is to launch a mint flavoured version of Kit Kat in the UK, the company said on Wednesday.
Last year Nestle launched an orange flavoured version of the popular chocolate wafer bar and was inundated with requests for a mint variant, said Nestle spokesman, Paul Kirkwood.

"We are responding to public demand and we expect Kit Kat Mint will encourage people who haven't eaten standard Kit Kat for a while to try it again, resulting in a long term sales increase for the brand," he said.
Kit Kat Mint will feature special green foil packaging to distinguish it from traditional Kit Kat.
However, mint fans will find that Kit Kat Mint will not be on shelves for very long. Kit Kat Orange was withdrawn after only two months.

"It is unlikely that Kit Kat Mint will become a permanent line although we will review the situation. A large part of the reason for the popularity of limited editions is their novelty value," said Kirkwood.
Kit Kat is Britain's biggest selling confectionery brand.
